{{Short description|Danish physicist (born 1937)}}
'''Jens Aage Als-Nielsen''' (born 21 January 1937) is a Danish physicist.

He took the [[dr.philos.]] degree in 1965, was employed at [[Risø DTU National Laboratory for Sustainable Energy|Risø National Laboratory]] from 1961 to 1995 and was a professor at the [[University of Copenhagen]] from 1995 to 2007. He was a co-creator of the [[European Synchrotron Radiation Facility]].<ref name=sde>{{cite encyclopedia|year=|title=Jens Aage Als-Nielsen|encyclopedia=[[Store Danske Encyklopaedi]]|url=https://denstoredanske.lex.dk/Jens_Aage_Als-Nielsen|language=Danish|accessdate=4 July 2021}}</ref>

Als-Nielsen received the Hewlett-Packard Award in 1985 and the [[Velux Foundation]] honorary award in 2011.<ref name=sde/> He was a fellow of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]] from 1996.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.dnva.no/c26849/artikkel/vis.html?tid=26861|title=Utenlandske medlemmer|publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]]|language=no|access-date=2 July 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070715102608/http://www.dnva.no/c26849/artikkel/vis.html?tid=26861|archive-date=15 July 2007}}</ref>
